summary: Behind a load balancer or proxy (ALB, NLB, HAProxy, Squid, Nginx, tinyproxy), controller uses `REMOTE_HOST_HEADERS` (default `["REMOTE_ADDR", "REMOTE_HOST"]`) to find the client IP. Set Remote Host Headers in Settings > Automation Execution > System to `["HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR", "REMOTE_ADDR", "REMOTE_HOST"]`; the first IP found wins.
questions: How do I get the real client IP in controller behind a load balancer?
Controller logs show load balancer IP instead of client
How do I add X-Forwarded-For to automation controller?

answer_card.title: Trust X-Forwarded-For
answer_card.answer_md:
**Settings > Automation Execution > System > Edit**, Remote Host Headers:
```json
[
  "HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR",
  "REMOTE_ADDR",
  "REMOTE_HOST"
]
```
Pair it with a Proxy IP Allowed List so the header can't be spoofed.
